chunks: We said: 'Descend from it, all of you. Then if guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will have no fear, nor will they grieve.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for having no fear or grief according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is pivotal as it outlines the covenant of descent, linking the earthly trial to the ultimate return to God through the acceptance of divine guidance (al-huda). The promise of 'no fear nor sorrow' is often interpreted by scholars like Al-Tabarsi as referring specifically to the believers who adhere to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams, who are considered the living manifestation of this guidance. Thus, it establishes the theological foundation for salvation through following the divinely appointed leaders after the Prophet.
